ashby:cinder:5cc00bde-02a4-409b-aa54-e3f.summary:

ashby:code-metal:5752bf59-4fc0-4fd6-be72.summary: Code Metal is the leader in automated software engineering you can trust. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck in software has shifted from writing code to verifying it works, and AI cannot verify its own work with certainty. Code Metal takes a fundamentally different approach: constrain AI to what it does reliably, verify every step independently of the model using formal methods, and keep engineers in the loop on the decisions that matter. The result isn't code that probably works — it's code that is provably correct, with auditable proof. Customers including the U.S. Air Force, L3Harris, RTX, and Toshiba use Code Metal to modernize legacy code, optimize performance on real hardware, and move prototypes to production, fast. Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

ashby:extend:4514adfd-fe86-4186-b929-4f1.summary:

We're looking for a Technical Account Manager at Extend. You will own the technical and commercial health of a book of 40–50 of our mid-market and startup customers. We are looking for a technical seller: someone an engineering team trusts to debug their integration, and who can then turn that trust into renewals, expansions, and saved contractions.

sections.title: Why You Should Consider Joining
bullets: We've grown revenue 6x YoY with our growth continuing to accelerate (8 figures, 200%+ NRR)
We have a product loved by users and being used in mission-critical flows at enterprises (Square, Zillow, Chime) and startups (Brex, Mercury, Checkr), and many more

Build the early-warning system: define which events and actions tell us an account is healthy, expanding, or at risk, and turn that into reporting and playbooks we can reuse across the long tail

Frontline technical support: answer customer questions, work through API issues (keys, JSON output, logs) far enough to scope the problem, and escalate cleanly to our support and document engineering teams

4–6 years of experience in customer success, account management, solutions, or technical support at a developer tools, data/analytics, or AI-native software company
Ideally 1-2 years at a growth stage startup

It means stepping beyond your role, taking full accountability, and doing what it takes to deliver results. bullets: Manage the partner lifecycle from first activation through expansion and maturity.
Build, nurture, and strengthen relationships with existing partners across our partner ecosystem to continue growth.

ashby:g2:078cc02f-28b9-451c-a61e-581fbf0.summary:
G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users.

Now, we have joined forces with Capterra , SoftwareAdvice , and GetApp to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. With 200M+ combined annual visitors and 6M verified reviews, we are now the centralized place to enable software buyers to make better and faster decisions with confidence.

And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI.

paras: At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— ( P erformance + E ntrepreneurship + A uthenticity + K indness. sections.title: About The Role
paras: G2’s data becomes more valuable when it helps customers make better decisions and works inside the systems they already use. We are looking for a Principal Product Manager who combines technical expertise with strong business acumen to help grow our Data Solutions business and lead the ecosystem of APIs, integrations, partner capabilities, and MCP- and agent-enabled workflows that brings G2 data to market.

You will own the product strategy and roadmap that supports four broader business goals: Data Solutions revenue and pipeline growth; customer MCP adoption and usage; expansion of MCP surface area through partners; and integration cleanup and migration. Your contribution will vary by goal—sometimes through direct ownership of product capabilities and migration work, and sometimes through close partnership with commercial, Partnerships, Data, and Engineering leaders.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can lead product strategy and work directly with code. You should be able to translate business use cases into technical builds, prototype API or MCP integrations and ship targeted code when that is the fastest way to validate an approach or unblock delivery while engineering remains accountable for production architecture, quality, reliability, and sustained implementation.

sections.title: Ecosystem Strategy and Product Architecture
bullets: Own the strategy and roadmap for how G2 data is exposed and activated through APIs, MCP, strategic integrations, and developer and partner surfaces.

Own the integration hub service, developer portal, and public-facing surfaces used by Marketing Solutions customers, Data Solutions customers, and partners, including the health, rationalization, and migration of the integration portfolio.
Define the platform capabilities that should be built once and reused across customers, partners, and use cases.

Work with Partnerships to identify the partners that can most effectively expand MCP surface area and customer value, while deciding whether each use case belongs in MCP, an API, or a more custom integration.
Prioritize investments using customer evidence, revenue opportunity, partner readiness, technical leverage, and strategic differentiation.
Make clear build, buy, partner, and defer decisions.

sections.title: Technical Discovery and Delivery
bullets: Work closely with Engineering and Data teams on APIs, data contracts, authentication, permissions, reliability, and developer experience.
Prototype integrations and ship targeted code when doing so accelerates learning, proves an approach, or unblocks delivery.
Create reusable patterns that let other G2 product teams safely expose their workflows through MCP without the Ecosystem PM owning every product-specific use case.
Translate technical constraints and architecture choices into clear customer and business tradeoffs.
Stay close to implementation details without losing accountability for the product strategy and outcome.

ashby:gen-digital:13ceda2e-38c2-42e9-a56.summary:
Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate — leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.

sections.title: About Gen
paras: When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career — from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs.

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.
If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We're looking for a Director of Product, Marketplace Expansion & Growth to lead the development of new consumer products and marketplace experiences across Gen's portfolio of trusted brands, including LifeLock, Norton, Avast, and Norton Money.

This is a senior, hands-on product leadership role with a unique opportunity to build new products from zero to one, discover product-market fit, and unlock meaningful growth opportunities across an established ecosystem serving millions of consumers.

Our ambition is to expand the reach and value of our financial marketplace capabilities across Gen's owned-and-operated consumer brands. But the opportunity goes well beyond traditional marketplaces. We want to create new consumer experiences that combine financial education, personalized insights, intelligent recommendations, and relevant products and services to help consumers make better financial decisions.

sections.title: Marketplace Expansion & New Product Strategy
bullets: Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for expanding financial marketplace capabilities and related consumer experiences across Gen's owned-and-operated brands.
Identify and validate new consumer product opportunities, developing experiences from initial concept through product-market fit, launch, and scale.
Explore opportunities across financial products, insurance, credit, lending, savings, financial wellness, and adjacent consumer needs.
Build new products and experiences that leverage Gen's existing distribution, customer relationships, consumer insights, and marketplace capabilities.
Develop a clear strategy for which opportunities to pursue, how to validate them, and what it takes to turn successful concepts into scalable products.

sections.title: Consumer Product Innovation & Personalization
bullets: Design compelling consumer experiences that connect financial education, personalized insights, recommendations, and relevant products and services.
Develop contextual experiences that help consumers discover useful solutions based on their needs, behaviors, and financial circumstances.
Shape the evolution of products such as Learn Hub and explore new approaches to education, financial guidance, product discovery, and consumer engagement.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, conversational experiences, and intelligent recommendations to make financial products more accessible, personalized, and actionable.
Establish a high-velocity experimentation approach to test new product concepts, learn from consumer behavior, and continuously improve the experience.

ashby:halter:4968589e-e06b-415c-9d3b-f0b.summary: At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

sections.title: About Halter
paras: We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .
To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .

sections.title: About the role
paras: As an Enterprise Onboarding Specialist at Halter, you lead the rollout of Halter across our largest and most complex customers - multi-ranch operations running thousands of cattle across multiple sites, locations and management teams.

These are our highest-stakes deployments. They involve multiple stakeholders, from ownership and executive teams through to ranch managers and crew on the ground. Success depends as much on relationship management, executive alignment and change management as it does on getting the technology working in the field.

You'll own onboarding for these customers: building the deployment plan across sites, managing senior stakeholders, supporting them to train animals, educating managers and crews, solving problems as they surface, and setting the operation up so Halter scales across their whole business, not just the first ranch.

sections.title: What your day could look like
bullets: Build and run multi-site rollout plans, sequencing ranches, aligning resources and keeping complex timelines on track
Manage senior stakeholder relationships, from owners and executives to ranch managers and crew, keeping everyone aligned on the plan and the outcomes
Act as the trusted, single point of ownership through onboarding
Lead training that lands across an enterprise account for all users
Work directly with managers and crew on ranch to embed Halter into day-to-day operations
Navigate the change management side of enterprise adoption - differing levels of buy-in, established ways of working, and teams who need to be brought along on the journey
Partner closely with Sales, Support & Product to coordinate seamless onboarding
Solve problems quickly and adapt plans as conditions, people and priorities change

sections.title: Who are we looking for
bullets: Significant experience owning senior customer relationships - relationship management, enterprise customer success, key account management, or customer experience leadership
A track record with large, complex, multi-site or multi-stakeholder customers, where success depended on managing people as much as managing a plan
Credibility with senior stakeholders: you're comfortable in a room with owners and executives, and equally comfortable in a field with a crew
Experience leading complex rollouts or change programmes end-to-end
Commercial judgment - you understand how these customers make decisions and what expansion depends on

Comfort working cross-functionally: pulling in the right people and keeping everyone aligned
Clear, straightforward communication, and the ability to pitch it right for the audience in front of you

Create a coherent platform story that connects native integrations, partner-built experiences, developer access, and agent connectivity without reducing the message to “we integrate with X.”
Develop audience- and use-case-specific narratives for security executives, security operations and vulnerability-management leaders, technical champions, developers, partners, and field teams.
Clarify the difference between NodeZero’s high-signal, attacker-validated intelligence and generic telemetry, vulnerability volume, or disconnected point-tool workflows.

sections.title: What you’ll do

Own and guide technical implementations, including M365, SSO, SCIM, and other enterprise integrations.
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Technical Specialists to design, validate, and deliver customer-specific architectures and requirements.

sections.title: About Mira Mace
paras: Mira Mace is a venture-backed company on a mission to help Medicare patients navigate a complicated healthcare system with clarity and confidence. Our advocates cut through insurance denials, medication costs, transportation gaps, and paperwork so patients get what they need — without fighting alone.

paras: You are the first person a patient talks to at Mira Mace. Patients sign up and call us, or we call them shortly after they sign up. That first conversation sets the tone for everything that follows: you listen, learn about their health and what they're dealing with, explain how our services work and how Medicare covers them, and book their first visit with one of our doctors before you hang up.

This is a phone-first, patient-facing role for someone who is warm, clear, and knows how to talk with Medicare patients. It is non-clinical — you won't be giving medical advice — but your CHW or LPN background is what lets you understand what a patient is telling you, ask the right follow-up questions, and explain the next step in words they trust.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Answer calls from patients who just signed up, and call new signups back quickly — the first conversation usually decides whether someone gets care.
Lead with empathy: listen to what the patient is going through, and learn about their health, their goals, and what has been getting in the way.
Explain what Mira Mace does, how our services are covered by Medicare, and what happens next — in plain language, without jargon.
Confirm the basics: Medicare coverage and plan details, contact information, and anything the care team needs to get started.
Book the patient's first doctor's visit on the call, and make sure they know how to join it.
Follow up with patients who didn't answer or weren't ready yet — persistent, respectful outreach by phone and text.
Document every conversation in our platform, accurately and as you go.
Maintain confidentiality and comply with HIPAA, privacy, and all applicable platform standards.

sections.title: Who You Are
bullets: Deeply empathetic. Older adults feel heard when they talk to you, even when they're anxious, skeptical, or hard of hearing.
Fluent in Medicare. Original Medicare vs. Medicare Advantage, Part B, supplemental plans, deductibles — you can explain them simply because you've done it hundreds of times.
Great on the phone. You build trust in the first minute, keep the conversation moving, and close with a booked visit.
Organized under volume. You can hold a full queue of callbacks without dropping anyone, and your documentation is clean without being chased.
Comfortable with technology and quick to learn new tools (CRMs, scheduling, and messaging platforms).

ashby:siro:fdbe9841-a1e1-4d65-837e-7ec28.summary:
Field sales powers the economy — but most teams are struggling. Reps are buried in admin work, managers are stretched thin, and leaders can’t see what’s really happening in the field.

Siro is redefining how field sales teams learn, perform, and win.

We started as an AI-powered coaching platform that helped reps improve their outcomes in the field.

sections.title: The role
paras: We’re hiring a Senior Manager or Director of Product Marketing to tell the story that makes Siro inevitable for in-person sales teams. sections.title: Key Responsibilities
bullets: Positioning and messaging: Own a clear point of view on who we sell to, what problems we solve, and why we win, including a messaging framework for each of our target verticals.

Competitive positioning. Own how we win, whether we’re up against a direct competitor or against the way a team has always operated. Keep our competitive intel current and turn it into battlecards our reps can win with.

Bottom-of-funnel messaging. Own the pages, customer stories, and copy that move an in-market buyer from interested to convinced. Solution and comparison pages, one-pagers, and industry-specific proof that makes Siro feel built for them.

ashby:solace:ee8ee239-ad20-4c1e-868d-335.summary:

ashby:vclusterlabs:d013e453-00e0-4bc3-ac.summary:
As a Customer Success Engineer at vCluster, you aren't just managing accounts — you are the primary architect of customer outcomes after the deal closes. Sitting at the intersection of technical depth and customer strategy, you ensure our customers — from hyper-growth AI Clouds to Global Fortune 500 enterprises — realize the full value of their investment and keep expanding it.

You are not a reactive support resource. You are a proactive partner who drives adoption, identifies expansion opportunities, and spots churn before it becomes visible. You build deep relationships with Platform Engineering leaders, DevOps teams, and executive buyers alike — and you can talk credibly with all of them.

sections.title: Your Role and Impact:
bullets: Onboarding Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer onboardings — from the sales handoff through to project close. You coordinate architecture workshops, platform installation, access setup, integration configuration, and operational readiness reviews. You set the tone for how customers experience vCluster from day one.

Success Planning: Build and maintain customer success plans that document business objectives, KPIs, adoption milestones, and a forward plan. You treat the success plan as a living document that drives every customer conversation, not a one-time deliverable that sits in a folder.

Proactive Engagement: Own the customer relationship cadence — regular check-ins, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Executive Business Reviews. You do not wait for the customer and you run executive reviews that reinforce strategic partnership, not just feature updates.

Renewal and Expansion: Own the renewal motion for your accounts — starting 90+ days out. You recognise expansion triggers — new use cases, AI/GPU workloads, additional Tenant Clusters, tier upgrades — and you work with the Account Executive and Solutions Engineer to convert them into growth that solves real customer problems.

Customer Advocacy: Serve as the internal voice of your customers. You represent their feature requests, escalate blockers, and provide actionable feedback to Product and Engineering grounded in real account context — not anecdote.

sections.title: This Role is a Fit for You If:
bullets: Proven Post-Sales Experience: You have experience in a technical post-sales role — customer success, technical account management, or professional services — with a track record of driving adoption and measurable business outcomes across a portfolio of technical customers.

Stakeholder Range: You can run an executive business review with a Head of Technology in the morning and troubleshoot an onboarding question with a platform engineer in the afternoon. You adapt your communication without losing depth or credibility in either direction.

Structured and Proactive: You operate with a clear framework — success plans, adoption milestones, renewal timelines — and you don't need to be reminded to use them. You identify risk before the customer tells you about it.

Commercial Awareness: You understand what drives renewal and expansion in a SaaS or platform business. You surface growth opportunities that solve real customer problems, not just opportunities that look good on a pipeline report.

sections.title: Bonus Points For:

Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, GPU compute environments, or customers building internal developer platforms at scale.
Background working with regulated industries — financial services, healthcare, or public sector -- where compliance and governance add complexity to technical decisions.
Contributions to the Kubernetes or open-source ecosystem.
Experience at a Series B-D startup where you've operated with autonomy and helped build a repeatable post-sales motion from the ground up.

sections.title: About vCluster Labs
paras: We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Jefferson at Home by BAYADA is seeking a Client Services Manager to join our Horsham, PA Home Health Office. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated professional who enjoys building relationships, coordinating services, and contributing to the growth of a team.

If you have a background in healthcare, strong organizational and communication skills, and a desire to take on increasing responsibility, this role offers the opportunity to develop your leadership skills while making a meaningful difference in the lives of clients and their families.

At Jefferson at Home by BAYADA, we believe our clients deserve care delivered with compassion, excellence, and reliability. Join a collaborative, close-knit team where your contributions matter and your professional growth is encouraged.

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of…

sections.title: The Role
paras: Ordering directly from a restaurant or retail shop should be intuitive and feel dependable. Customers should know where their order is, hear about and easily follow updates, and get help quickly when something goes wrong.

We’re hiring a Product Manager to own that experience at Square, across food ordering and retail ecommerce. You’ll build customer experiences and seller tools for pickup, delivery, and shipping, helping businesses earn trust and bring customers back.

The problems are concrete: How do you follow an order’s progress? What should happen when a delivery runs late or an item goes missing? How do you make a refund clear, or give a seller an easy way to make things right? You’ll own the experience from the moment an order is placed through its arrival and any help needed afterward.

sections.title: You Will
bullets: Own the strategy and priorities . Set the direction for Square’s post-checkout customer experience across food ordering and retail. Use customer needs and business goals to decide which problems matter most, where to invest, and what can wait.

Bring the work together . At Block, engineers and people across teams also lead individual product improvements. You will connect those efforts across Square and external partners, spot gaps, resolve competing priorities, and make sure the pieces form a clear, consistent customer experience as more people prototype and ship.

Design and define user experiences . Work closely with design and engineering to shape key customer journeys, from tracking an order to getting help when something goes wrong. Bring personal taste and attention to detail to the flows, interactions, and communications that build trust.

Help the team scale through automation . Use AI and other tools to connect and automate repeatable work across customer research, analysis, prototyping, product development, and launch. Build reusable workflows, share what works, and give teams the context and tools to make good decisions independently.

Prototype and ship improvements yourself . Use AI tools to turn ideas into working prototypes, test them with customers, and learn quickly. Use GitHub and other developer tools to contribute changes through pull requests and work with engineers to ship improvements to production.

Own the outcomes . Follow work through launch and use customer feedback and data to guide improvements. Measure whether customers feel informed, get problems resolved quickly, and choose to order again, using signals like order-status inquiries, resolution time, satisfaction, and repeat purchases.

sections.title: You Have
paras: While there is no specific deadline to apply for this role, U.S. roles are typically open for an average of 55 days before being filled by a successful candidate. Please refer to the date listed at the top of this job page for when this role was first posted.

bullets: 6+ years of product management experience.
Consumer product judgment. You’ve shipped customer-facing products at scale that make complicated things feel simple. You can explain your decisions and what you learned from customer behavior.

Hands-on building with AI. You use AI to build working prototypes, automate recurring work, and test ideas. You can use GitHub and other tools to make a change and submit a PR. You can show what you’ve built and what you learned.

Taste and craft. You work closely with design and bring personal taste and a high bar for quality. You recognize generic or weak output, give specific feedback, and iterate until the experience feels thoughtful and useful.
Strategy and prioritization. You’ve set product direction and turned it into clear priorities. You make thoughtful tradeoffs and can explain what deserves investment and what can wait.

Customer research and analytical judgment. You use customer conversations, research, and behavioral data to guide decisions. You’re comfortable moving forward when the problem is ambiguous or the data is incomplete.
Leadership across teams. You bring people together around a clear direction, resolve disagreements, and get work shipped. You give others the context to make good decisions and keep moving.

Relevant experience. Experience with consumer products, ecommerce, marketplaces, or customer support is a plus, but not required. You’re curious about how businesses operate and what makes customers trust them.

greenhouse:boulevard:4699330006.summary:
Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen .

sections.title: Who is Boulevard?
paras: We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most .

sections.title: Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.
paras: Every salon, spa, and medspa deserves a front desk that never misses a call, never drops a message, and always knows what to say. Boulevard’s AI Receptionist is building that: agentic AI that handles client communication across voice and text so businesses can grow faster, operate leaner, and deliver an exceptional experience every time. As the product manager for AI Receptionist, you’ll own that vision end to end.

For a self-care business, the front-of-house experience is where client relationships are made or broken, so getting this right matters. It’s one of Boulevard’s highest-visibility bets, at a well-funded company early enough in its AI journey that you’ll genuinely shape the direction. Your work will have a direct, tangible impact on how thousands of small businesses show up for their clients.

sections.title: What you’ll do here:
bullets: Set the vision, roadmap, and success criteria for the AI Receptionist suite, our answer to the modern contact center for self-care businesses.

Own how AI engages clients one-to-one across voice and text: when it handles conversations on its own, when it hands off to staff, and how that handoff feels seamless to clients and effortless for the team.
Shape how conversations stay continuous across channels, and design fallback behavior for when AI can’t resolve something.
Own the business outcomes (revenue, adoption, and retention) and define the product metrics behind them, like autonomous resolution rate, agent productivity, and CSAT.
Collaborate on pricing strategy and connect what’s happening in the product to what it means for our customers’ businesses.
Build deep fluency in how self-care businesses manage client communication today: what they trust, what they fear, and what they’d delegate in a heartbeat or never let out of human hands.

sections.title: What you’ll need to thrive:
bullets: 5-8 years in product management, with experience in B2B2C or both B2C and B2B environments, so you know what it means to serve a business and their end customer at the same time.
Experience shipping AI-powered products: you know how to shape how AI behaves, design for when it falls short, and earn user trust over time.
LLM fluency: enough hands-on familiarity with LLMs and prompt design to partner credibly with engineering without needing a translator.
AI-native habits in your own practice: you use tools like Claude daily, run side projects, and stay close to how the technology is evolving.
Strong voice-of-customer instincts, including building for users who are skeptical of automation and designing for trust.
Data fluency: you’re comfortable defining metrics, pulling your own analysis, and building the case for roadmap bets with evidence.
Cross-functional leadership: you’ve influenced engineering, design, and data teams without relying on authority, and kept multiple workstreams moving in parallel.
Clear communication: you can translate complex AI product decisions for business owners, cross-functional partners, and leadership alike.

sections.title: ABOUT THE ROLE
paras: As Director of Product, Payments, you'll lead product across the Payments group (money movement, member accounts and risk, and disputes). You'll partner closely with leaders in Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance and Data Science, and with our bank and payment partners, to prioritize work based on impact and drive strong execution. This role reports to the SVP of Product.

sections.title: RESPONSIBILITIES

Make the calls that cut across squads, while product leads own their own roadmaps
Set the metrics that measure success, and communicate impact and risks across the organization
Build AI-enabled ways of working into how the team plans, builds and makes decisions

sections.title: ABOUT YOU

A hands-on leader: you stay close to the work while coaching leads and product managers with empathy, and you know when to step in and when to step back
Range and judgment: you pick up new areas quickly, and make sound calls with incomplete information in regulated, high-stakes environments
AI fluent: you use AI tools in your own work and push your team to do the same
Outcome oriented, not reactionary, with excellent written and verbal communication skills

sections.title: An overview of this role

You'll rethink how intent becomes actionable work, how that work moves through software development, and where human involvement is needed.

You'll develop a point of view on planning's future and turn it into product decisions with engineering, design, and product leadership. That includes exploring how planning could connect work to business priorities and budgets, rather than assuming the answer is already decided. sections.title: The Role
paras: Every sourcing event run on Glo generates structured data on purchase intent, supplier pricing and performance, negotiation outcomes, and award decisions. As a Data Product Manager at Globality, you will own the strategy for capturing, structuring, and compounding that data into a proprietary asset that makes Glo smarter with every event and makes Globality's market position defensible. You will set the requirements for what data we collect, how it is structured and governed, and how it flows back into the platform to improve agent performance and customer outcomes. You will also own the analytics and benchmark products that give customers insight into their sourcing results. You will partner with Engineering, Machine Learning, the AI Product Manager, and Product leadership to run data as a product with its own roadmap, users, and measurable return.

sections.title: What You Will Do
bullets: Own the data product strategy and roadmap, defining how Globality captures, structures, and compounds customer and sourcing data into a defensible, proprietary asset.

Identify which data creates durable competitive advantage, including purchase intent, should-cost benchmarks, supplier pricing and performance, negotiation outcomes, and award decisions, and prioritize investment accordingly.

Design the instrumentation strategy that captures high-value signals at every step of the intake-to-award process, in partnership with the product managers who own each workflow, closing gaps where data is lost or left unstructured.

Define canonical data models, taxonomies, and entity resolution for suppliers, categories, and commercial terms so data from every customer, ERP platform, and procurement system can be unified and reused across the platform.

Build the feedback loops that turn sourcing outcomes into training data, evaluation sets, and benchmarks that improve Glo's agents, including target pricing, supplier discovery, negotiation strategy, and award recommendations.

greenhouse:humaninterest:8165328.summary:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

greenhouse:hummingbirdregtech:6176123004.summary:
Hummingbird is a remote-first, fully distributed team united by the shared mission of helping fight financial crime. greenhouse:huntress:8210679003.summary:

sections.title: Your Role at impact.com :
paras: We’re hiring a technical Product Manager for the Action Processing (AP) and Contracting Squad — one of impact.com’s most foundational domains: how brands and partners define terms, commissions, lists, and contract workflows that power revenue on the platform.

This is a step up from associate-level execution. Ownership and delivery of value / outcomes are the core of this role: you own feature sets end-to-end, define what success looks like, and are accountable for shipped results — not only clear tickets and on-time delivery.

You have already made the shift to building with AI: you use agents and modern AI tooling to ship real artifacts (specs, prototypes, analyses, internal tools, personal projects). You’ll bring that operating system into a systems-heavy product domain and raise the quality and speed of requirements, tradeoffs, and delivery.

sections.title: Ownership, outcomes & delivery
bullets: Own feature development for Action Processing (AP) and Contracting Squad initiatives (e.g. terms/commission behaviors, list and audience rules, contract workflows, and customer-driven requests).
Define success up front (metrics / OKRs), ship, and follow through on outcomes — adoption, quality, rework reduction, or business impact — not just output.
Write high-quality customer and business requirements that reduce rework and protect engineering focus.

Develop Markdown requirements that live adjacent to the GitHub repo (versioned next to eng context, not only in Confluence/docs silos); lead pre-spec and spec reviews and drive release prioritization. Optimize for short time from ask → usable draft → eng-ready.
Partner with Engineering through build: surface risks early; make crisp tradeoffs under incomplete information and own the recommendation.

sections.title: Technical product craft & AI-native building
bullets: Operate as a technical PM in a systems-heavy domain: map system behavior, data flows, edge cases, and cross-squad dependencies with limited coaching.

Use AI tools and agents as a core part of how you build — at work or in personal projects — to draft and pressure-test specs fast, synthesize research, prototype flows, explore edge cases, and accelerate analysis. AI should cut time to a good requirement, not inflate polish time.

Walk through concrete AI-assisted builds you’ve shipped (prototypes, scripts, internal tools, product experiments, side projects): what you built, how agents/tools fit, what you validated, and how quickly others could react.
Run analyses from source data and convert findings into insights, conclusions, and recommendations that drive prioritization and outcome tracking.

Sequence work with Engineering leads; facilitate working sessions across Engineering, Design, Customer Success / Technical Services, and adjacent PMs.
Hold alignment touchpoints that keep priorities clear and reduce coordination drag.

greenhouse:incommonwith:4516902009.summary:

Through ongoing collaborations with our peers in the worlds of art and design, Quarters crafts a vision of home that’s unfolding and alive.

greenhouse:stripe:8361184.summary: Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

sections.title: About the Team
paras: The Solutions Architecture team partners with Stripe’s users to design and build transformative solutions that unlock growth, modernize business models, and shape the future of commerce. We work with executives, product leaders, and engineering teams at the world’s largest and most innovative companies, helping them translate ambitious strategies into scalable solutions on Stripe.

Strategic Accounts Solutions Architecture serves Stripe’s most complex and consequential users. The team combines deep technical expertise, commercial judgment, and customer empathy to solve problems that often have no established playbook. Its work not only helps individual users grow; it also surfaces emerging needs and opportunities that can inform Stripe’s product strategy and create value for users at global scale. These Solution Architects are deeply embedded in these users and are working along as their technical co-founders.

The Head of Strategic Accounts, Solutions Architecture will lead a team of senior architects who are trusted partners to strategic, key, and major accounts. This leader will set the vision for the team, develop exceptional technical talent, and work closely with account leadership to deepen and grow Stripe’s most important relationships. They will also build a strong partnership with Product and Engineering, turning insights from leading-edge customer engagements into the next wave of innovation across Stripe.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Set the vision, strategy, and operating model for Strategic Accounts Solutions Architecture, aligning the team’s priorities with Stripe’s user, product, and business objectives.
Recruit, lead, coach, and retain a world-class team of senior Solutions Architects supporting Stripe’s strategic, key, and major accounts.
Partner with account leaders to develop and execute technical account strategies that deepen customer relationships, unlock new use cases, and drive durable growth.
Lead from the front in the team’s most complex and high-impact engagements, including architecture workshops, executive briefings, solution design, technical evaluations, and critical escalations.
Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior executives, product leaders, and engineering leaders at the world’s largest and most innovative companies.

Build a close, durable partnership with Stripe Product and Engineering teams; synthesize patterns from strategic accounts, influence product priorities, and help translate customer needs into scalable capabilities for all Stripe users.
Create mechanisms for senior architects to share technical insights, reusable patterns, and field learnings across Stripe.
Establish a culture of technical excellence, curiosity, accountability, experimentation, and continuous learning.

A track record of hiring, developing, and leading senior technical talent in a complex, high-growth environment.

Deep technical fluency and the ability to remain hands-on—quickly understanding architectures, APIs, data flows, integration patterns, security and reliability considerations, and emerging technologies.
Experience partnering directly with senior customer executives, product leaders, and engineering leaders on complex, business-critical initiatives.
Demonstrated success connecting technical strategy to account growth, customer outcomes, and long-term partnerships.
Strong experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmaps, shape requirements, and turn customer insights into scalable product innovation.
An AI-enabled approach to leadership and problem-solving, with practical experience using AI tools to increase the quality, speed, or scale of work.
Exceptional curiosity and learning agility, including a strong desire to explore new technologies, business models, and ways of working.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: The Senior Customer Experience Manager (Sr. CXM) is Artera's single point of accountability for a book of Specialty, Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) and Community Health Center (CHC) accounts. This is an end-to-end relationship role: you own the customer from pre-close introduction through implementation, go-live, ongoing engagement, renewal, and expansion. You won't execute every task — but you're accountable for every date, including the work other teams touch.

This role sits within Artera's newly unified Customer Experience Management function, which combines our former Customer Success Management and Project Management teams into one accountable owner per account. You'll run implementations, drive adoption, monitor account health, and quarterback expansion conversations alongside your counterparts from sales, configuration and development. You'll do this across roughly 50–60 FQHC and CHC accounts — a high-volume book where every account has C-suite exposure and where staying ahead of health signals is the difference between renewal and quiet churn.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Own the customer relationship end-to-end. Serve as the primary and accountable point of contact for ~50–60 FQHC and CHC accounts, from pre-close introduction through implementation, adoption, renewal, and expansion.

Build C-suite credibility. Present outcomes, ROI, and workflow impact directly to CEOs, CFOs, CMOs, and operational leadership. Adapt data and messaging to the audience — ROI and outcomes for the C-suite, workflow impact for operations, integrations and performance for IT.

Drive value realization. Move accounts from "nice to have" to "must have" through consultative engagement on patient access, workflow, and outcomes. Build and deliver data-driven executive business reviews that quantify ROI, connect results to customer goals, and open the door to expansion conversations and reference-ability.

Manage churn proactively. Small FQHCs don't escalate when they're unhappy — they quietly don't renew. Build a system for monitoring health signals across a high-volume book and act before flags become churns.
Partner with sales on renewal and expansion. Work closely with AE counterparts to identify expansion opportunities, build the business case, and support the customer through the sales cycle.
Operate as the escalation ceiling. Customers should not need to escalate above this role except in exceptional cases.

Use AI in your daily work. Draft outreach, prep for calls, summarize meetings, manage follow-ups, and stay ahead of a 50+ account book by embedding AI tools in your daily workflow. This role is not sustainable without it.
Travel to your customers. Roughly 25% travel, including on-site business reviews, go-lives, and executive meetings.

sections.title: The Work
paras: The Senior Account Manager, Special Loans and Restructuring, is responsible for managing commercial default files, certain commercial loans designated as “problem accounts”, which include but are not limited to conventional and construction facilities while adhering to underwriting standards and the Company’s policies and procedures (including AML requirements, as applicable). The incumbent is responsible for enforcing the conditions of the mortgage contract on facilities in default as directed by Management, while providing proactive and efficient resolutions/work out strategies to avoid legal action when feasible while minimizing losses to the Bank. The incumbent at times will act as the key primary contact for communicating and co-operating with both internal and external stakeholders (such as legal counsel, real estate agents, brokers, partners and other internal departments within the Bank) and representing the Bank in the professional community to ensure transactions are processed in a timely and efficient manner.

The Senior Account Manager, Special Loans and Restructuring will provide direct support to the Associate Director, Special Loans and Restructuring by performing a variety of functions associated with default management, including underwriting/credit analysis, portfolio management/monitoring, reporting, projects and initiatives and other administrative duties, which may include ad hoc requests by Senior Management.
In addition, the incumbent will assist with completing site inspections as required for portfolio management purposes and/or default loans.

sections.title: The Core Responsibilities
paras: The incumbent will manage and/or administer complex delinquent and problem commercial mortgages (generally loans exceeding $2.5MM) while minimizing losses to the Bank, process loans for legal action for non-payment (including past maturities, tax arrears, insurance cancellations, bankruptcies/liens, etc.) and conduct full financial review prior to recommending appropriate legal remedies to Senior Management, manage legal action loans and enforce on remedies/conditions as warranted, while ensuring compliance with established default/workout strategies are implemented in a timely and efficient manner. Liaising with key stakeholders, both internal and external, will be a key responsibility, and forms part of determining and negotiating successful workout strategies.

The incumbent is responsible for performing, reviewing and correlating all aspects of underwriting (including collateral analysis and valuation) for defaulted loans and problem accounts, while ensuring that each submission addresses heightened risk elements, as identified, including monitoring and ensuring risk ratings on default loans are updated timely and reported to the appropriate internal stakeholders.

The incumbent will work closely with the Mortgage Services team and provide assistance to manage, monitor and/or resolve commercial delinquencies and certain default loans deemed to be non-performing, while providing timely updates to Senior Management as warranted.
